instructions: Read README.md. Use native Electron Forge/Vite commands; stop editor, preview, build and packaging jobs before cleanup. These rules describe scope, not standing permission to delete.

rules.name: generated-output
rules.instructions: Reproduce using npm run package/make and npm run build:web. Retain packages needed for release or review before authorizing removal. Preview the shared remover; apply needs project-root writes for isolation. User artwork and prefab files are never generated output.

rules.name: review-evidence
rules.instructions: Review captures/logs for useful milestones or regressions. Use bounded Luna high/standard classification when useful. Preserve selected originals with known revision, source path, caption and checksum before proposing exact removals. Unknown provenance and same-disk archive size must remain explicit.
